name: C++23 Learning with Clang-19 + clangd
postCreateCommand: echo '🎓 Setting up C++23 learning environment...' && mkdir -p /workspace/build && if [ ! -f /workspace/build/std.pcm ]; then echo '📚 Building C++23 std module (only when needed)...' && echo '📝 Command: clang++-19 -std=c++23 -stdlib=libc++ --precompile -o std.pcm /usr/lib/llvm-19/share/libc++/v1/std.cppm' && clang++-19 -std=c++23 -stdlib=libc++ --precompile -o /workspace/build/std.pcm /usr/lib/llvm-19/share/libc++/v1/std.cppm && echo '📝 Command: clang++-19 -std=c++23 -stdlib=libc++ -c std.pcm -o std.o' && cd /workspace/build && clang++-19 -std=c++23 -stdlib=libc++ -c std.pcm -o std.o && echo '✅ C++23 std module ready for learning!'; else echo '✅ C++23 std module already exists - skipping rebuild'; fi && echo '🏗️ Configuring CMake...' && cd /workspace && cmake -B build -S . && echo '🎯 C++23 Learning Environment Ready!'
